capture.note: the mapped decks were traced ON the Gotland 2022 image, so its agreement with them is self-agreement; the April flight is the independent record

rules.hypothesis: the model's own derivation: the back tee on the observed platform, each shorter tee walked up the observed route by the card's difference from the back tee
rules.flatnessIsCorroborationOnly: 35% of the played box is flatter than 0.10 m over 5 m, so a flatness test cannot detect a deck on this links

selfScore.meaning: the mapped decks were traced on the 2022 summer capture, so recovering them on the 2026 April flight is a cross-capture test of the reading, not of the trace

verdict.adopted: no outline; the derivation in build-course.mjs teeMarks places the marks and this file corroborates it
verdict.why: the reading recovers only 10 of the 17 MAPPED decks on the independent April flight, at a median 5.4 m from their centres and with areas 0.21 to 1.88 times theirs. An instrument that misses two of every five features it is calibrated on, and sizes the rest between a fifth and twice, cannot be trusted to outline features nobody has mapped.
verdict.whatItDoesSupport: 90 of the 108 derived tee points have a compact mown patch within 26 m, on 52 distinct patches. That is corroboration that the derived points land on mown ground rather than in scrub, water or a bunker -- separately verified: no derived mark lands in water, a bunker, a building or on a green. It is NOT evidence that a constructed tee deck stands at each one, and must not be read as such.
verdict.whatWouldFinishIt: a club record of its own tee positions, or a leafed-on ortho at 0.16 m or finer. The one leaf-on capture here is 0.25 m and 2022, and is the image these decks were traced FROM, so it cannot arbitrate its own trace.
